description: This file defines an abstract PHP class 'View' within the SuiteCRM framework, extending from a base View class. It provides methods for rendering templates, configuring translations, and managing PDF-related settings in the administration module, specifically for generating PDFs in the SuiteCRM application.

classes.name: View
classes.description: An abstract class that handles rendering utilities for the PDF module in the SuiteCRM administration interface, including setting up translation and PDF configuration.

methods.name: preDisplay
methods.description: Configures translation strings, global variables, and PDF settings before rendering the view.

methods.name: getButtons
methods.description: Returns HTML for cancel and save buttons by fetching a Smarty template.

methods.name: getEngines
methods.description: Returns a list of available PDF rendering engines with translated labels.
